title: When music opens a door
adaptation_note: 仅用于展示点词与原句制卡，不是正式700–900词学习稿
paragraphs: A song can make us curious about an unfamiliar world. We may begin with the sound of a guitar and end up reading about the people who changed an entire musical tradition.
His worldly outlook shaped the music he made. He listened to people from different backgrounds and found fresh stories in ordinary conversations.
Curiosity gives us a reason to read another paragraph. A word we meet in a memorable sentence becomes part of a story we want to revisit.

worldly.ex: His worldly outlook shaped the music he made.

curiosity.ex: Curiosity gives us a reason to read another paragraph.
